summary: Describes SPAKE2, a protocol in which two parties who share a password derive a strong shared key without revealing the password. It works with any suitable group and has a security proof. It was not selected in the CFRG PAKE competition but is published because of existing use.

eli5.summary: Two people who both know a secret word can build a strong secret key together without ever saying the word out loud.

questions: how does password-authenticated key exchange work
